parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The role of the node in the instance. Valid values:

* **mongos**: mongos node.
* **db** : shard node.
* **logic** : logical instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-audit-log-filter --db-instance-id dds-bp12c5b040dc0000 --role-type logic --region cn-hangzhou
